job.question: In the American Academy of Actuaries' 2011 RFP for retirement plan and related consulting services, what were the plan assets at 12/31/10 of each of its three retirement plans?
job.expected_facts: Money Purchase plan: $3,015,682; 401(k) plan: $1,993,513; Defined Benefit plan: $647,181 (all as of 12/31/10).
job.acceptance: Accept amounts mapped correctly to Money Purchase, 401(k), and Defined Benefit; profit-sharing description is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2021 Delaware Office of the State Treasurer RFP, not the American Academy of Actuaries’ 2011 RFP. It contains no 12/31/10 asset figures for the three retirement plans in the question.
quotes: ISSUED BY THE OFFICE OF THE STATE TREASURER

The DC Program encompasses three distinct Plans: (1) the State’s deferred compensation plan under IRC § 457(b) (the “457(b) Plan”); (2) the State’s tax-sheltered annuity plan for certain education employees under IRC § 403(b) (the “403(b) Plan”); and (3) the State’s employer match plan under IRC § 401(a) (the “Match Plan”).
